$comment: Hand-written expected results for fixtures/specs/qa/host-variables.yaml (criterion 29). 'withList' is diagnose with the vendored Public Suffix List snapshot; 'strict' is diagnose with publicSuffixes: null. 'callable: false' means exactly one server-not-callable finding for that server; 'callable: true' means none. 'fix' is null where the finding carries no fix, else what the one fix must be. Rows 0 to 9 are the worked-examples table of ADR 0004 'The fix for an open host variable', copied in order; the table was written against the list as published on 2026-11-26 and must be re-checked against the snapshot when it is vendored (ADR 0004). A test compares the 'url' and 'withList.callable' of rows 0 to 9 with the ADR's table text.
pointerRule: The finding is located at the server object, '/servers/<n>'. ADR 0004 does not say whether it is the server, its 'url' or the variable; '/servers/<n>/url' and '/servers/<n>/variables/<name>' are accepted while question QA-7 is open.

fixTemplate.title: List the allowed hosts for this server. They are published in the spec, and the first one becomes the default.

input.name: values
input.label: Allowed hosts, one per line. The first becomes the default.

fixTemplate.rule: ADR 0004 'The fix for an open host variable': 'Title and label', 'Input' and 'Patch'

servers.rule: ADR 0004 row 1. Strict: with no list every host variable without an enum is not callable; no fix, since {x} does not end the host
ADR 0004 row 3: the label {x}example is followed by .com, a public suffix
ADR 0004 row 4: co.uk is a public suffix (ICANN section)
ADR 0004 row 5: github.io is a public suffix (private section)
ADR 0004 row 6: a single label not on the list is a public suffix by the default rule
ADR 0004 row 7: the text after {region} holds a variable; region needs an enum

ADR 0004 row 8: nothing follows the label, so clause (b) fails; the variable is the whole host, so the fix is offered with format host-name. The fix's conditions do not depend on the list, so strict mode offers it too (ADR 0004 'Strict mode': the fix is offered only for a variable that ends the host)
ADR 0004 row 9: other text comes before the variable in the host, so format host-suffix
ADR 0004 row 10: no host variable; a port variable never causes the finding by its position, with or without the list
Criterion 29, last clause; ADR 0004 'server-not-callable': a variable whose enum is empty allows no value, and no fix is offered

findings.exactCodesRule: Every variable has a default. A variable for which the allowed-hosts fix is offered is never also server-variable-no-default (ADR 0004 'One fault, one finding, one fix').
